name: notion_database_row_update
description: Update property values or the archived status of a database page (row) (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id})

page_id.description: Identifier for the database page (row) to update.

properties.description: JSON-encoded property values to write, keyed by property name. Replaces the stored property values when provided.

archived.description: Whether the page is archived (deleted). Set to true to archive the row.
